title: Merge Arbitration — agent narrative input
description: Written by the merge-arbiter agent to .github/.pipeline-context/merge/<issue_id>.arbitration.json after reading <issue_id>.score.json (the deterministic score, gates, and computed decision from compute-score.js). Consumed by scripts/render-verdict.js. The score and computed decision are facts this file does not alter. A visible override may only make a computed Cleared decision more conservative by blocking it.

narrative.description: Plain-language explanation of the decision: what the five checks found, why the score/gates land where they do, and what a reviewer should read first if they want to understand this patch's readiness in one paragraph.

applied.description: False by default — the computed decision stands. Set true only to change a computed Cleared decision to Blocked with a specific, evidenced reason. An override is never silent: render-verdict.js always shows both decisions side by side.

decision.description: Required when applied is true. An override may only block; it may not clear a computed Blocked decision.

reason.description: Required when applied is true. Must cite specific evidence from one or more of the five upstream reports — never a general feeling of confidence or caution.
